title: Klusiaaa's Admin Panel
description: This Project Adds An admin panel with time, weather, gamemode swapper and item giver
body:
Klusiaaa’s Admin Panel — A modern dialog‑based admin toolkit for Minecraft
Klusiaaa’s Admin Panel is a lightweight, intuitive, and fully interactive admin toolkit built using the new Minecraft 1.21+ Dialog System. It provides a clean and user‑friendly interface that allows server operators to perform essential administrative actions without typing commands manually.

This datapack includes several core modules:

Gamemode Swapper – instantly switch between Creative, Survival, Adventure, and Spectator

Time & Weather Controller – set the time of day or change the weather with a single click

Give Any Item – quickly give yourself any item in the game

Give Items with Components – generate items with custom components (NBT‑style attributes)

Author Icons – each module displays the creator’s player head as a signature

The panel is perfect for SMP servers, creative worlds, testing environments, and private playthroughs.
It requires no mods or plugins — everything works in pure vanilla Minecraft.

The project is actively maintained and open to community suggestions.
If you want to contribute your own modules, the system automatically displays your player head as the author.

Activate The Panel with the /function admin:menu Command
